producers.title: Producers
producers.producer_2_description: A professional cook who makes croquettes for you.
producers.producer_3_description: An industrial fryer that produces croquettes on a large scale.
producers.producer_4_description: An automated croquette factory. Approved by Chicote.
producers.producer_6_description: Advanced robot that produces croquettes at a high rate.
producers.producer_7_description: Imports croquettes from all over the world for mass distribution.
producers.producer_8_description: Veneration and promotion of the croquette.
producers.producer_9_description: An interdimensional portal that brings croquettes from other universes.
producers.producer_10_description: AI that dominates the universe and produces croquettes on a large scale.
producers.producer_11_description: Corporation that exploits resources from different timelines to manufacture croquettes.
producers.producer_12_description: A quantum engine that synthesizes croquettes instantly.
producers.producer_13_description: A star-sized croquette with infinite flavor.
producers.producer_14_description: A self-aware program that modifies the game's code to create more croquettes.
producers.producer_15_description: The ultimate expression of the croquette producer: Yourself, obsessed beyond madness.
producers.producer_16_description: A synchronized click grid that never sleeps.
producers.producer_17_description: Chained shifts, hot pans and zero breaks.
producers.producer_18_description: Fry snacks in zero gravity to keep the crunch perfect.
producers.producer_19_description: An industrial line that already smells like victory and clean oil.
producers.producer_20_description: Researches how to make better croquettes faster and at scale.
producers.producer_21_description: Second-generation hardware with zero fear of hot oil.
producers.producer_22_description: Distributes croquettes across neighborhoods, stadiums and airports.
producers.producer_23_description: Faith moves mountains and entire trays.
producers.producer_24_description: Links bars from parallel realities at peak hour.
producers.producer_25_description: The fryer folded into itself and somehow became profitable.
producers.producer_26_description: The corporation no longer sells croquettes. It sells crispy civilizations.
producers.producer_27_description: A stable core of thick sauce and impossible energy.
producers.producer_28_description: Every layer spawns another batch, then another, then another.
producers.producer_29_description: Hot-patches reality to compile more appetizers.
producers.producer_30_description: The version of you that farms, cooks and optimizes at once.
producers.producer_31_description: Thousands of automatic impulses working like a single finger.
producers.producer_32_description: Regulates national snack production with bureaucratic obsession.
producers.producer_33_description: A full orbital ring of industrial fryers spinning without rest.
producers.producer_34_description: The whole map smells like freshly made croquettes.
producers.producer_35_description: Collects every possible recipe and executes them instantly.
producers.producer_36_description: It is no longer a robot. It is an entire species.
producers.producer_37_description: Coordinates delivery, marketing and hunger across half the galaxy.
producers.producer_38_description: A brotherhood that protects the sacred crunch at any cost.
producers.producer_39_description: Exports appetizers between timelines without paying customs.
producers.producer_40_description: The absolute heart of croquette production.
producers.producer_41_description: The brand already colonized entire systems with bechamel alone.
producers.producer_42_description: Condenses flavor, heat and matter into a single spoonful.
producers.producer_43_description: The longer you stare at it, the more croquettes appear.
producers.producer_44_description: Compiles infinite production in real time.
producers.producer_45_description: The player who understood this game a little too well.
producers.producer_46_description: Stars also click when nobody is watching.
producers.producer_47_description: A factory so ancient it now produces out of habit.
producers.producer_48_description: Beyond this point there is only crunch.
producers.producer_50_description: It does not produce croquettes. It defines how many fit in the universe.

tutorial.welcome: Hi! I'm Croquetita. Welcome to the world of croquettes! Click on the big croquette to start your culinary adventure.
tutorial.first_click: Excellent! You've just cooked your first croquette. Keep clicking to get more!
tutorial.keep_clicking: You're doing great! Every click counts. When you have enough croquettes, you can buy automatic producers.
tutorial.first_producer: You can now buy your first producer! Go to the menu on the right and buy a "Click" that will automatically cook croquettes.
tutorial.first_upgrade: Upgrades increase the number of croquettes per click. Invest in them wisely!
tutorial.producers_tip: Tip: The most expensive producers are more efficient. Save up for the best ones!
tutorial.keep_upgrading: You're making great progress. Don't forget to buy upgrades to increase your croquettes per click.
tutorial.thousand_milestone: 1,000 croquettes! This is just the beginning. The croquette empire awaits you.
tutorial.balance_tip: Balance your investment between producers and upgrades for maximum efficiency.
tutorial.five_thousand: 5,000 croquettes! You're on the right track. Keep it up!
tutorial.ten_thousand: 10K croquettes! You already have a real factory. Did you know you can change the look of your croquette?
tutorial.skins_unlock: Visit the Skins section to customize your croquette. There are many different designs!
tutorial.fifty_thousand: 50K... This is getting serious. You'll soon reach numbers you never imagined.
tutorial.hundred_thousand: 100,000 croquettes! You are officially a master croquette maker.
tutorial.quarter_million: A quarter of a million... Who knew clicking could be so addictive?
tutorial.half_million: 500K croquettes. You surely have achievements unlocked!
tutorial.first_million: ONE MILLION CROQUETTES!!! You are officially a croquette-millionaire!
tutorial.million_advice: With these numbers, advanced producers are starting to be worth it. Invest heavily!
tutorial.five_million: 5 million... Have you considered opening a croquette franchise?
tutorial.ten_million: 10M! At this rate, you'll soon be swimming in croquettes (not literally... or will you?).
tutorial.twenty_five_million: 25 million croquettes. This is no longer a game, it's a lifestyle.
tutorial.fifty_million: 50M croquettes. Have you tried all the skins? There are whole collections to discover!
tutorial.hundred_million: 100 MILLION! You are no longer human, you are a living legend of clicking.
tutorial.quarter_billion: A quarter of a billion... The numbers don't even make sense anymore. But keep going!
tutorial.half_billion: 500M. A piece of advice, high-level upgrades multiply your production exponentially.
tutorial.first_billion: ONE BILLION!!! There's no turning back now. You are the king of croquettes.
tutorial.five_billion: 5 billion croquettes. You could feed an entire country. Or three.
tutorial.ten_billion: 10B... Do you still remember what your first click was like? Those were the days...
tutorial.fifty_billion: 50 billion. Warning: These numbers can cause dizziness.
tutorial.hundred_billion: 100B! Your production per second is probably higher than the GDP of some countries.
tutorial.half_trillion: Half a trillion... Do you still have achievements to unlock? Check them out!
tutorial.first_trillion: ONE TRILLION!!! We're not in Kansas anymore, Dorothy. Not even on Earth.
tutorial.ten_trillion: 10 trillion. At this point, it's just abstract numerical art.
tutorial.hundred_trillion: 100T. Tip: Premium producers are your best investment now.
tutorial.first_quadrillion: QUADRILLION! The mathematicians are proud. Your parents... not so much. But congratulations!
tutorial.quintillion_zone: Quintillion reached. You lost touch with reality a long time ago. Keep it up!
tutorial.sextillion_warning: Sextillion... I'm worried about your mental health, but I respect your dedication.
tutorial.septillion_madness: Septillion. You have officially transcended. You are one with the croquettes.
tutorial.octillion_gods: Octillion... The croquette gods watch you with respect and a little fear.
tutorial.nonillion_legend: A... Nonillion? I had to Google that number. Go outside for a while.
tutorial.decillion_limit: A decillion... I think that's enough. Go for a walk, please.
tutorial.more_and_beyond: More than a decillion? Seriously, go see the sunlight. The croquettes can wait.
tutorial.clicks_1000: 1,000 clicks! Your finger deserves a medal.
tutorial.clicks_10000: 10K clicks... I hope you're using good hand ergonomics.
tutorial.clicks_100000: 100K clicks!!! Your mouse will never be the same. F for your mouse.
tutorial.level_5: Level 5! You're no longer a rookie. High-level upgrades are close.
tutorial.level_10: Level 10 reached. Mid-level upgrades are now available!
tutorial.level_20: Level 20! You're a veteran now. Late-game upgrades await you.
tutorial.level_30: Level 30... The most powerful upgrades are now within your reach. Use them well!
tutorial.level_50: LEVEL 50!! You are a legend. Only the most dedicated get here.
tutorial.level_75: Level 75 reached. Are you still there? Incredible dedication!
tutorial.level_100: LEVEL 100! You have mastered the art of croquettes. You are an inspiration to all.
tutorial.level_200: LEVEL 200!! You are a living legend in the world of croquettes.
tutorial.tip_efficiency: Calculate the cost per croquette/second of each producer to optimize your strategy.
tutorial.tip_combo: Upgrades and producers work in synergy. Combine them wisely!
tutorial.tip_achievements: Many achievements are hidden. Experiment to find them all!
tutorial.tip_patience: Patience is key. Sometimes it's better to wait and save for the next big upgrade.
tutorial.tip_active_vs_idle: Did you know? You can play actively or passively. Find your style!
tutorial.humor_addiction: Remember that croquettes are not real but your addiction is.
tutorial.humor_grass: Please, go out and touch grass from time to time.
tutorial.humor_sleep: Have you slept today? The croquettes will be here when you get back. Probably.
tutorial.humor_family: Your family misses you. But I understand that croquettes are your priority.
tutorial.humor_finger: Remember to stretch your fingers. We don't want you to end up with carpal tunnel syndrome.
tutorial.humor_croqueta_addict: If croquettes were a drug, you'd already be in rehab. Keep it up!
tutorial.humor_infinite_clicks: Do you think you can make infinite clicks? Keep trying!
tutorial.humor_croqueta_universe: In some parallel universe, you are already the emperor of croquettes.
tutorial.motivacion_1: You can do it! Every croquette brings you closer to greatness.
tutorial.motivacion_2: Don't give up now. The big numbers are just around the corner.
tutorial.motivacion_3: You are amazing. Look how far you've come since that first click.
tutorial.help_navigation: Use the menus to get the most out of your croquette experience.
tutorial.help_achievements: Did you know you can see all your detailed achievements?
tutorial.help_skins: Skins don't give bonuses, but they make your croquette look great or at least different...
tutorial.general_help: Need help? Explore the different menus or just keep clicking. You decide!

intro.title: Welcome
intro.body: I'm Croquetita, your guide. In this tutorial I'll teach you the basics: how to earn croquettes, XP and level up.

points.title: Croquettes
points.body: Click on the big croquette to earn croquettes. Producers can generate croquettes automatically.

experience.title: Experience
experience.body: Gain experience by cooking croquettes. Level up to unlock bonuses and content.

producers.title: Producers
producers.body: Producers automatically generate croquettes. Buy and upgrade them to speed up progress.

upgrades.title: Upgrades
upgrades.body: Upgrades increase croquettes per click and producer efficiency. Prioritize them wisely.

events.title: Events
events.body: Special events spawn occasionally with bonuses or penalties.

skins.title: Skins
skins.body: Skins are cosmetic. Unlock them via achievements, levels or special tasks.

finish.title: Ready
finish.body: Great! You know the basics. Explore the game and come back to the tutorial anytime.

contracts.title: Daily contracts
contracts.subtitle: Three rotating goals that push a different session every day and give the current run a sharper payoff.
contracts.bonusSubtitle: When you complete all three daily contracts you unlock an extra reward and extend your weekly streak.

clickWarmup.title: Do {{target}} clicks to get started
clickWarmup.description: A quick push to get the session moving.

clickSprint.title: Do {{target}} manual clicks
clickSprint.description: Great if you want to progress through active play.

clickMarathon.title: Do {{target}} clicks in one session
clickMarathon.description: Made for longer sessions where you keep clicking a lot.

clickOverdrive.title: Push your manual clicks to {{target}}
clickOverdrive.description: An advanced challenge for finishing a strong session with active play.

levelSpark.title: Gain {{target}} levels
levelSpark.description: Helps you unlock content quickly and get up to speed early.

levelPush.title: Gain {{target}} levels today
levelPush.description: Push the run forward and get closer to fresh unlocks.

levelBreakthrough.title: Gain {{target}} extra levels
levelBreakthrough.description: For the moment when you need one big push through the next wall.

producerBootstrap.title: Buy {{target}} producers
producerBootstrap.description: Set up an automatic base so you do not rely only on clicking.

producerSpree.title: Buy {{target}} more producers
producerSpree.description: Grow your steady production during the session.

producerFleet.title: Expand production with {{target}} producers
producerFleet.description: A good midgame target to stabilize your CpS growth.

producerEmpire.title: Reach {{target}} producer purchases
producerEmpire.description: A late challenge for building a large, stable economy.

upgradeHunt.title: Buy {{target}} upgrades
upgradeHunt.description: Strengthen your run by picking up useful upgrades early.

upgradeSweep.title: Buy {{target}} upgrades
upgradeSweep.description: Make better use of the shop and do not leave key upgrades behind.

upgradeForge.title: Buy {{target}} advanced upgrades
upgradeForge.description: Made for polishing the run once your production is already strong.

eventRush.title: Capture {{target}} special events
eventRush.description: Turn special events into a real source of advantage.

eventStorm.title: Capture {{target}} special events
eventStorm.description: A long-session challenge where you do not want to miss any spawn.

prestigeReady.title: Perform {{target}} prestige today
prestigeReady.description: End the day by resetting the run in exchange for a permanent upgrade.

debug.title: Debug Menu
debug.panelTitle: Fast control and live game snapshot
debug.panelDescription: Inspect the current run, adjust key values and trigger testing actions from one place. The save stays marked as debug until you reset it.
debug.overviewDescription: Immediate summary of economy, progression and current session activity.
debug.progressDescription: Useful indicators to check whether the run is balanced or ready to test a specific stage.
debug.inputDescription: Edit the most important game values directly without leaving the panel.
debug.bulkDescription: Testing utilities to unlock content or prepare a test save in seconds.
debug.dangerDescription: Destructive actions that fully alter the current save.
debug.dangerWarning: A full reset wipes economy, progression, prestige, skins and achievements from the current local save.

confirm.title: Enable debug mode
confirm.message: You are about to enable the internal debug panel to inspect the run and edit progression directly. The save will stay marked as "debug" until you reset it.

resolution.message: Reload the page to adapt to the new resolution

news.title: News
news.noNews: No news available for this level.

offline.title: Welcome back!
offline.message: While you were away, {{amount}} croquettes were produced.

report.title: Reports & Statistics
report.debugOnlyBody: Enable debug mode to access advanced reports, tables, and charts.

assessment.title: Report coverage
assessment.subtitle: Quick summary of the report elements and their usefulness for understanding the game state and progression.
assessment.reportStructureValue: 3 tabs, separated cards, headed tables, and PDF export.
assessment.tableUtilityValue: 14 tables across player data, contracts, debug info, skins, and multiplayer rankings.
assessment.chartUtilityValue: 12 charts covering distribution, progress, ROI, curves, and game comparisons.
assessment.filterCoverageValue: 6 working filters for producers, upgrades, achievements, and skins.
assessment.catalogCoverageValue: 50 producers, 50 upgrades, and the original 33 skins integrated into the shop, reports, and PDF.
assessment.calculatedFieldsValue: 12+ derived metrics such as ROI, percentages, per-minute pace, efficiency, progress, and cumulative cost.
assessment.pdfStructureValue: Title, numbered sections, tables, charts, coverage block, footer, and page numbering.
assessment.multiplayerCoverageValue: Includes both level and contracts leaderboards with detail, distribution, and top players.

multiplayer.title: Multiplayer
multiplayer.noData: No leaderboard data available. Try again later.

report.upgradeClickCurveHint: Shows how click power scales as required level increases.
report.upgradeCumulativeCurveHint: The area chart highlights how much total click power becomes available as you progress through upgrades.
